Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social

Class FederatedOAuth2UserService

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social.FederatedOAuth2UserService
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.userinfo.OAuth2UserService<org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.userinfo.OAuth2UserRequest,org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.user.OAuth2User>
public class FederatedOAuth2UserService extends Object implements org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.userinfo.OAuth2UserService<org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.userinfo.OAuth2UserRequest,org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.user.OAuth2User>
The user service of the providers that are plain OAuth 2.0 (GitHub), which have no ID token: the framework's service reads the profile from the provider's API, the verified primary e-mail address is read from /user/emails (through the domain port VerifiedEmailLookup, implemented by the GitHub adapter of infrastructure/github with a client generated from the contract of that GitHub operation), the account is resolved (found, linked by verified e-mail or provisioned, and refused when it may not sign in) and the principal becomes the local one, named after the account. The stable subject is GitHub's numeric id, never the login name or the e-mail address, which the user can change.
